title: Questions and Answers on the Seasoning of Reinvested Class H Preferred Stock Dividends — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Reinvested dividends on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding season according to the holding's reinvestment record.

## The rule

The dividend seasoning period rests on the holding's reinvestment record: for a holding carrying at least 20 reinvested dividend entries, reinvested dividends are seasoned at once; for a holding carrying at least 8 but fewer than 20, they are unseasoned for 3 whole months; for a holding with fewer, for 6 whole months.

The holding's unseasoned reinvested dividends are those dated within that many whole months back from today, counting whole calendar months; they are the dividend part of the holding's unseasoned shares, which are not redeemable.

## Questions answered

**What is a reinvested dividend entry?** Each quarterly dividend booked to the holding as reinvested in additional preferred shares; all such entries over the life of the holding are counted.

**A holding has 20 reinvested dividend entries. Are any of its dividends unseasoned?** No. With 20 or more entries every reinvested dividend is seasoned at once.

**A holding has 12 entries, the latest dated 2 months ago and the one before 5 months ago. Which are unseasoned?** Only the one dated 2 months ago: the period is 3 whole months.

**The same dividends on a holding with 6 entries?** Both: the period is 6 whole months.

## Ladder

| Reinvested dividend entries on the holding | Reinvested dividends are unseasoned for |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | No period — seasoned at once |
| 8 to 19 | 3 whole months |
| 0 to 7 | 6 whole months |
